messages:
maria_pm: Quick heads-up — customer Atlas wants an accelerated ramp for the new routing fallback. Need to align on canary plan + SLA. They want 50% traffic in EU within 4 weeks. Thoughts?

alex_se: TL;DR: we can do staged regions: EU canary -> EU ramp -> global. Need telemetry gates for latency and P95 errors. Also need feature flag + tenant opt-in.

sam_sre: +1 on telemetry. Propose hard SLOs: p95 < 200ms, error rate < 0.5% (5m rolling). If breached, automated kill to fallback. Also prefer a soft-degrade step before full cutoff.

ops-bot: :robot_face: Canary kicked off on eu-1 pool at 1765432200 — monitor https://console.redwood.ai/rollouts/atlas (metrics stream enabled).

jordan_re: For evaluation, recommend a small A/B with quality probes: control vs variant. Start with 0.1% shadow, then 1% AB for 48-72h. Track hallucination-rate, helpfulness score, and token-cost delta.

maria_pm: Contract note: Atlas expects no customer-visible blackouts. They asked for SLA uplift if we commit to 50% EU. We need clear rollout criteria to agree to that. Alex — can you draft the flag steps?

alex_se: Flag: rollout/atlas/fallback_v2
Config snippet:
```
steps:
  - day0-1: 0.1% shadow (no routing)
  - day2-4: 1% AB (real routing)
  - week2: 10% EU (gradual ramp)
  - week3: 50% EU (target)
kill_conditions:
  - p95_latency_ms > 200 for 10m
  - error_rate_pct > 0.5 for 5m
  - token_cost_ratio > 1.5 for 1h
fallback_sequence:
  - degrade_model (smaller instance/quantized)
  - route_to_dedicated_pool
  - flag_off (full rollback)
```

alex_se: Also plan for canary region mirrors (EU-west and EU-central) with cross-region failover window of 30s. Need feature to snapshot KV caches pre-failover.

maria_pm: Can we include an automated quality-eval hook that notifies PM & RE if hallucination delta > 2%? Atlas insisted on that.

jordan_re: Yes, add an eval job every 12h comparing sample prompts. Actionable alerts: slack @maria_pm + @jordan_re if drift detected.

sam_sre: I'll add runbook stubs: "on degrade_model": who runs, steps to warm dedicated pool, verification checklist. Also add telemetry dashboards and a paged scrub for persistent regressions.

maria_pm: OK I'll draft the SLA amendment and share with Atlas ops/legal. Next steps: Alex to push flag config + ops playbook, Jordan to set up eval probes, Sam to author runbook pages. Ping here when ready. :thumbsup:
